description: This file defines APIs, enums, structs, and function prototypes for managing coredump operations in Zephyr OS, including querying, verifying, erasing, copying, and outputting coredump data, with conditional compilation for debug support.

methods.name: coredump
methods.description: Performs a coredump with a specified reason, exception context, and thread info.

methods.name: coredump_memory_dump
methods.description: Dumps a specified memory region for coredump.

methods.name: coredump_buffer_output
methods.description: Outputs a buffer to the coredump backend.

methods.name: coredump_query
methods.description: Performs a query on the coredump subsystem.

methods.name: coredump_cmd
methods.description: Performs a command on the coredump subsystem.
